feeding_claim.verbatim: Finished with high-quality, locally sourced grains for superior marbling and taste.

pickup_locations: Processor in Mountain View, or a pre-arranged meeting

availability.note: October through December 2026 sold out; January has 2 whole beef, 4 halves or 8 quarters left.

notes: Order by call or text, $100 deposit. Cattle kept on open pasture and fed hay; finished steers get a custom grain blend while staying on grass pastures. Family will deliver to the customer by arrangement; no delivery area named. Farm visits by appointment. Steaks and ground beef also sold at Big Springs, a family restaurant. Goats, eggs and vegetables on the Hector page belong to the related Cowell Farms near Russellville, so only beef is listed. Second phone (870) 615-0060.
